//: Lives in the Angular repo (e.g. legacy/extract.config.json). Paths are relative to this file.
//references: Framework reference assemblies (both folders) and nothing solution-wide. Globbing a shared output folder with hundreds of DLLs takes tens of minutes behind an antivirus.
//referencesFromProject: Resolve the csproj's own Reference and ProjectReference items by name in referenceDirs (the project's output folder, as printed by parity probe), plus HintPaths when they exist.
//framework: A .NET Framework legacy project: keep includeRuntimeReferences false and list the v4.x reference assemblies (installed with Visual Studio or the targeting pack). Mixing them with the embedded .NET 10 references makes System types ambiguous.
//guard: Read by legacy/hooks/guard-legacy.sh in the specify and implement phases. denyTools: more MCP tool-name globs to refuse (code-index and code-graph servers are built in). allowRoots: more readable directories besides this repo, relative to this file.
